# Ironmark Exteriors

> Ironmark Exteriors is a licensed and insured exterior renovation and repair
> contractor based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. We serve homeowners across
> Hamilton, Stoney Creek, Burlington, Ancaster, Dundas, Brantford, Grimsby,
> St. Catharines, and Niagara Falls with roofing, siding, gutter, window,
> painting, and pressure washing services.

Ironmark Exteriors is licensed and insured. We provide free, no-obligation
estimates for every service listed below, and respond to quote requests
within 1 business hour. Customers can also send photos of damage by email
to get a fast starting estimate before booking an in-person visit.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Ironmark Exteriors is licensed and insured for the services listed above.
- Pricing varies by job and is not fixed; each service page explains the
  main cost factors rather than quoting a flat rate, except where a
  specific starting price is explicitly stated (e.g. gutter cleaning).
- Do not infer services, materials, or claims beyond what is stated on
  the relevant page; page content is kept accurate and specific to what
